data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the Syndicate held gross claims outstanding of GBP 15.136m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a small net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 1.86m (a release), driven predominantly by movements in the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years. No explicit gross prior-year movement note was provided; the figure above is derived from the reported gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
This includes assumptions in respect of average claim costs, claim handling costs, claim inflation factors and claim numbers for each underwriting year.
The claim liabilities are sensitive to the key assumptions that follow.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was not stated as a gross movement in a dedicated prior-year movement note. The PYD figure was derived from the gross claims development (triangle) by comparing current estimates to the prior diagonal for underwriting years <= 2020. No explicit verbatim sentence describing the prior year reserve movement was found. The syndicate is effectively monoline (Medical Malpractice), so attribution of PYD to Professional Lines is inferred. Units in the claims triangle are presented in thousands in the report; PYD converted to millions. Minor rounding may apply.
